src/domain/rng.js ports the next/jump transition to JavaScript unsigned
32-bit operations. Project-specific wrappers add validation, immutable
state, explicit seeding, separated named streams and bounded integer draws.
Algorithm identifier: xoshiro128ss-v1.
This browser generator does not claim Nintendo DS sequence compatibility.
